summary: Produced the backend design artefact for OBS-01 structured logging, defining the logger module boundary, canonical JSON log schema, fatal BPM_LOG_LEVEL validation rules, deterministic sensitive-field redaction, API-09 request trace propagation, and UUID-based background trace generation for scheduler and timer work. No executable tests were run because this is a design-only step; completeness was validated by a manual traceability review against the handoff acceptance criteria and OBS-01 edge cases.

tests_run.name: design traceability review
tests_run.detail: All OBS-01 acceptance criteria and documented edge cases were mapped to explicit design sections, integration points, and validation notes.

next_steps: Route the artefact to BACKEND-DEV for implementation of the structured logging module and startup config validation.
Keep request logging aligned with the existing API-09 trace middleware and thread-local trace context design.
